description:
Introducing the Xion VorteX Trike: Conquer Any Terrain, Electrify Your Ride.

Unleash the future of off-road exploration with the Xion VorteX Trike, a state-of-the-art electric motorbike meticulously crafted to deliver unparalleled performance and a jaw-dropping aesthetic. Designed for the adventurous spirit and the style-conscious rider, the VorteX Trike isn't just a vehicle—it's a statement.

Striking Design that Demands Attention The Xion VorteX Trike boasts a truly unique and aggressive design, highlighted by its distinctive triangular frame. This illuminated frame features bold, intricate patterns and proud "VorteX" branding, radiating a cyberpunk vibe that's impossible to ignore. Complementing this futuristic silhouette are robust, oversized off-road tires, engineered to provide exceptional stability and unyielding durability across diverse landscapes—from loose sand and rugged trails to urban pavement.

Powerful Illumination for Any Journey Equipped with a formidable multi-bar LED lighting system, the Xion VorteX Trike ensures exceptional visibility. Whether you're navigating challenging trails in the dead of night or cruising through low-light environments, these powerful lights cut through the darkness, enhancing safety while perfectly accentuating the bike's cutting-edge aesthetic.

Performance-Driven for the Ultimate Thrill Beneath its captivating exterior, the Xion VorteX Trike is a beast of performance. Its advanced electric motor delivers exhilarating torque, ready to tackle any off-road adventure with ease. The finely tuned suspension system works in harmony with the robust chassis to provide a remarkably smooth and comfortable ride, absorbing bumps and uneven surfaces effortlessly. This is a machine where performance and style converge, making it the ideal companion for both gritty off-road escapades and sleek urban exploration.

A Unique Rider Experience For thrill-seekers and innovators, the Xion VorteX Trike offers an unmatched riding experience. It masterfully blends cutting-edge design with versatile functionality, setting itself apart from anything else on the road (or off it). Its bold visuals and powerful mechanics ensure you're not just riding a bike; you're commanding a piece of art that redefines personal mobility.

Designed for Boundless Exploration The Xion VorteX Trike encapsulates the very spirit of adventure. Imagine cruising along a vibrant city waterfront at night, its LED frame glowing as you pass, or exploring the tranquility of sandy beaches as the sun dips below the horizon. This bike is your ticket to discovering the world around you in an entirely new, electrifying way.

The Xion VorteX Trike is more than just a bike—it’s a testament to innovation and bold design, making it the ultimate choice for those who want to stand out, explore, and leave an unforgettable impression wherever their journey takes them.

An electric trike for adults

What is the best electric trike for adults? It depends on how you ride. If you want a fat-tire trike that handles sand, gravel and hills as well as pavement, the VorteX Trike is built for that: a 3-wheel Class 2 e-bike with a 72V battery, full suspension and hydraulic disc brakes, from $13,900. If you only ride short, flat paths, a lighter mobility trike may suit you better.

Why riders choose a fat-tire trike

Stability without balancing. Three wheels let you stop, start and stand still without putting a foot down.

Fat tires on any surface. Wide tires roll over sand, gravel, trails and curbs that stop a skinny-tire trike.

72V power and range. The 72V, 58Ah battery gives real torque for hills and hauling, with up to 60 miles per charge.

Room for gear or a passenger. A two-person seat and up to 900 lb of load capacity.

Electric trike FAQ

How much is an electric trike for adults?

The VorteX Trike costs $13,900 for the Stealth version and $14,850 for the Lightning LED upgrade.

Is a 3-wheel electric bike better than a 2-wheel one?

For stability, yes. You can stop and stand without balancing, and the fat tires and low center of gravity stay planted on rough ground. If you want a lighter, sportier ride, the two-wheel VorteX E-Bike starts at $6,950.

Do you need a license for an electric trike?

The VorteX Trike is a Class 2 e-bike (throttle and pedal assist up to 20 mph), so most U.S. states do not require a license, registration or insurance. Check your local rules before riding.

Can the VorteX Trike handle sand and trails?

Yes. Fat tires, full suspension and hydraulic disc brakes let it ride on sand, gravel, dirt trails and pavement.

Where is the VorteX Trike built?

It is assembled in San Diego, California, and ships to all 50 states fully assembled and ready to ride.
